subtopic: Sector Concentration and Overlapping Fund Holdings
source_evidence: you should check the top holdings of the funds to make sure they are different
question: Misconception: Owning several mutual funds or ETFs automatically means your investments are diversified, even if the funds hold many of the same investments.
answer: Having several funds does not necessarily provide the diversification you want. Check their top holdings to see whether they differ; funds with overlapping holdings may not spread your investments as much as you expect.
